text:
You need a cross-platform mobile chat app that gives pet owners fast, helpful answers from OpenAI and veterinarians, with smooth messaging, search, notifications, and a clear user experience.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building web and app interfaces with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’ve worked on chat experiences where responsiveness and reliability matter, and I’d be glad to help you design and build this app so it feels simple for pet owners while still supporting veterinarians behind the scenes.

A relevant project I worked on was the Streaming chat widget for Quillstack in edtech. I built the front end and Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streamed answers token by token using React, TypeScript, Server-Sent Events, Node.js, and the OpenAI API. One result was first token on screen in about 600 ms, and the product supported 30k chats a month. That experience translates well to your project, especially for fast AI responses, streaming message delivery, and making the chat flow feel immediate.

For your app, I’d focus on the core pieces that make the experience dependable: user registration and login, pet-owner and veterinarian profiles, in-app messaging, OpenAI-powered answers, search for previous questions, and a notification flow for new replies. I’d also make sure the UI stays clean and easy to navigate across devices, with settings and profile management that don’t get in the way of the conversation.

I’m comfortable working full stack, so I can help think through both the user-facing experience and the API/data flow needed to support messaging, ratings, and feedback. If you’d like, I can help turn this into a structured build plan and start with the chat, authentication, and AI response flow first.
